author: Shri Raghavendra Swami
commentary: अभ्यासादिहीनस्य फलं पृच्छति ॥  अयतिरिति ।  अयतिरप्रयत्नः श्रद्धया आस्तिक्यबुद्ध्या उपेतो युक्तः योगात् ध्यानरूपोपायात् चलितमानसः योगसंसिद्धिं ध्यानसंपूर्तिं ध्यानफलं ज्ञानमिति यावत् ।  अप्राप्य हे कृष्ण कां गतिं गच्छतीति ॥६.३७॥
translation:
Arjuna said: He who does not exert himself, (but) has faith, and who, the mind having been disturbed from Yoga, fails of the Yoga-accomplishment--what way does he go, O Krishna. (37)
V. Faith: the sense that there is something beyond this life to be reached. Yoga: is the contemplation, the means, Yoga-accomplishment: perfect Yoga, i.e., power to contemplate the Lord undisturbed by anything outside.
